<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>الدولة السعودية الأولى: التأسيس</title>
<style>
:root{--g1:#123B2C;--g0:#0C2B25;--g2:#226349;--au:#CBA566;--au2:#F8D39A;--sa:#EFE4CF;--iv:#FCF8EF}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;background:#061713;overflow:hidden;font-family:Tajawal,"IBM Plex Sans Arabic","Segoe UI",Tahoma,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--iv)}
#stage{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:1280px;height:720px;transform-origin:center;background:var(--g0);overflow:hidden}
#top{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:56px;background:var(--g0);border-bottom:2px solid var(--au);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 18px;z-index:20}
#top b{color:var(--au2);font-size:20px;white-space:nowrap}
#bar{flex:1;height:10px;background:#ffffff22;border-radius:9px;position:relative}#bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--au),var(--au2));transition:width .6s}.st{position:absolute;top:-4px;width:18px;height:18px;margin-right:-9px;border-radius:50%;background:#0C2B25;border:2px solid #ffffff55;transition:.5s}.st.on{background:var(--au2);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--au2)}#cv{position:absolute;top:-19px;margin-right:-11px;font-size:17px;transition:right .6s}
.ib{background:#ffffff14;border:1px solid var(--au);color:var(--au2);border-radius:10px;min-width:42px;height:38px;font:inherit;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
#bot{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;height:64px;background:var(--g0);border-top:2px solid var(--au);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 24px;z-index:20}
.btn{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--au2),var(--au));color:var(--g0);border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 30px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #8a6d33}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:none}.btn[disabled]{opacity:.35}
#scr{position:absolute;inset:56px 0 64px 0}
.scr{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .6s;overflow:hidden}.scr.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1c5a43f0,#123B2Cf0);border:2px solid var(--au);border-radius:22px;padding:22px 28px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0008}
h1{font-size:54px;color:var(--au2)}h2{font-size:38px;color:var(--au2);margin-bottom:12px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:all .7s}.rv.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.goal{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;font-size:27px;line-height:1.5;margin:10px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.goal.on::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 30%,#F8D39A55 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(120%);animation:sh 1.3s .2s forwards}
@keyframes sh{to{transform:translateX(-120%)}}
.num{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--au);color:var(--g0);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:26px}
/* opening */
#s0{background:linear-gradient(#f6b46a,#f8d39a 45%,#c9a15f 62%)}
.sun{position:absolute;left:45%;top:120px;width:170px;height:170px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(#fff6c8,#ffd37a 60%,#ffb44f);box-shadow:0 0 120px #ffd37a;animation:rise 6s ease-out both}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(160px)}}
.dune{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:100%}
.car{position:absolute;bottom:130px;font-size:70px;white-space:nowrap;filter:brightness(0) opacity(.8);animation:walk 18s linear infinite}
@keyframes walk{from{right:-30%}to{right:105%}}
#guide{position:absolute;right:50px;bottom:0;width:250px;transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform 1s}#guide.on{transform:none}
#cap{position:absolute;left:30px;right:340px;bottom:24px;font-size:25px;line-height:1.7;text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:.5s}#cap.on{opacity:1}
.eye{animation:bl 4s infinite;transform-origin:center;transform-box:fill-box}@keyframes bl{0%,94%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}97%{transform:scaleY(.1)}}
#head{animation:hd 5s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes hd{50%{transform:rotate(2.5deg)}}
/* shield game */
#s5,#s4{background:#0b1d2b}
.sky{position:absolute;inset:0;background:url(data:image/webp;base64,) center bottom/cover}
.sky::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(#1b2a52cc,#0000 70%)}
.jet{position:absolute;width:150px;cursor:pointer;animation:fl 3s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 6px #0008)}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translate(14px,-10px)}}
.ring{position:absolute;width:150px;height:96px;border:3px solid #ff3b3b;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;display:none;box-shadow:0 0 18px #f33;animation:rg 1s linear infinite}
@keyframes rg{50%{transform:scale(1.15)}}
#q{position:absolute;left:24px;bottom:16px;width:560px;display:none}
#q h3{font-size:25px;color:var(--au2);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.5}
.opt{display:block;width:100%;background:var(--sa);color:var(--g0);border:0;border-radius:12px;margin:7px 0;padding:11px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:23px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-align:right}
.opt.bad{background:#b33;color:#fff}.shake{animation:sk .4s}@keyframes sk{25%{transform:translateX(-10px)}75%{transform:translateX(10px)}}
.hud{position:absolute;top:12px;left:16px;font-size:26px;background:#000a;border:2px solid var(--au);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 16px;color:var(--au2)}
#pad{position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:50%;width:150px;height:30px;margin-left:-75px;background:#3a4a44;border:3px solid #8aa;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0}
#msg{position:absolute;top:70px;left:0;right:0;padding:0 40px;text-align:center;font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:#ffe08a;text-shadow:0 3px 10px #000;opacity:0;transition:.4s;pointer-events:none}#msg.on{opacity:1}
#mis{position:absolute;width:54px;display:none;z-index:5}
.fx{position:absolute;display:none;z-index:6;pointer-events:none}
.pop{animation:pp .9s forwards}@keyframes pp{from{transform:scale(.2);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1.25);opacity:0}}
#menu{position:absolute;inset:56px 0 64px;background:#000c;z-index:30;display:none;padding:30px 120px;overflow:auto}#menu button{display:block;width:100%;margin:8px 0}

/* The girl's avatar and the studio-recorded narration were imported from index (1).html. */
.girl-guide{height:294px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:9px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 20px #0005)}
.girl-halo{width:208px;height:208px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:3px solid #CBA566;border-radius:50% 50% 28% 28%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#fff8e8 0,#e8c38d 48%,#226349 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #123B2C33,inset 0 8px 28px #ffffff88;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.girl-icon{font-family:system-ui,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji",sans-serif;font-size:146px;line-height:1;transform:translateY(10px);animation:girlFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;user-select:none}
.girl-voice-bars{position:absolute;bottom:11px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:3px 9px;height:21px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;background:#123B2Ce8;border:1px solid #F8D39A;border-radius:18px;opacity:.45;transition:opacity .2s}
.girl-voice-bars i{width:3px;height:4px;background:#F8D39A;border-radius:5px}
.girl-voice-bars.speaking{opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 16px #F8D39A77}
.girl-voice-bars.speaking i{animation:girlTalk .43s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.girl-voice-bars.speaking i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.19s}.girl-voice-bars.speaking i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-.28s}.girl-voice-bars.speaking i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-.11s}
.girl-name{background:#123B2Ce8;padding:6px 20px;border:1px solid #F8D39A;border-radius:999px;color:#F8D39A;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.voice-retry{display:block;margin:4px auto;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid #F8D39A;background:#123B2C;color:#F8D39A;border-radius:8px;font:inherit;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}
@keyframes girlTalk{to{height:15px}}@keyframes girlFloat{50%{transform:translateY(5px)}}
#hint{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 12px}
</style></head><body>
<div id="stage">
 <div id="top"><b>الدولة السعودية الأولى: التأسيس</b><div id="bar"><i></i><span id="cv">🐪</span></div><span id="cnt" style="color:var(--au2)"></span>
  <button class="ib" id="bm" title="قائمة المحطات">☰</button><button class="ib" id="bs" title="المؤثرات">🔊</button><button class="ib" id="bn" title="الراوية">🎙</button><button class="ib" id="bf" title="ملء الشاشة">⛶</button></div>
 <div id="scr"></div>
 <div id="menu"></div>
 <div id="bot"><button class="btn" id="prev">السابق ▶</button><span id="hint" style="font-size:20px;color:var(--sa)"></span><button class="btn" id="next">◀ التالي</button></div>
</div>
<script>
const IMAM_POSTER="data:image/jpeg;base64,";
const VID="
